name: Primitive Finance
rootCause: A serious loophole has been discovered in the Primitive Finance smart contract on the Ethereum chain options agreement. Since the contract cannot be upgraded or suspended, the official chose to hack the smart contract to protect user funds. The hacked funds are safe. All hacked funds will be returned to their owners.
